Be Your Own Boss Run your salon your way. Set your own hours, prices, and schedule — all in your private suite. Enjoy the freedom to grow your business and live life on your terms. Create Your Brand Build a business that's uniquely yours. Design your suite, create your own atmosphere, and showcase your personal style. testimonials.author: Analise Bergesen
testimonials.text: Salon boutique is THE space for your small business. Very professional, great environment, newly renovated and pleasing to the eye. Sam, the property manager is extremely kind and helpful and truly wants the best for his tenants. Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking to rent a home for your small business.

testimonials.author: Stephen Powelson
testimonials.text: Just had my hair cut by Cynthia in suite 30. What a great experience. I'm super picky about my hair and was looking for a new place to go. Cynthia made me feel very relaxed and my haircut was awesome. I'll be back for sure. Thanks Cynthia,  I'm a customer for life! =]

testimonials.author: Kim Schwartz
testimonials.text: I go to Penny New at  New Vous Aesthetics! She has ALWAYS done a wonderful job doing all my waxing! She is VERY thorough and extremely professional! Penny makes you feel very comfortable no matter what body part you need to get waxed. Give her a try, you will really like her!
